aetheria.description: Declare that a Friction node blocks a Blueprint from reaching Ready status. The block holds until the Friction is Archived with a resolution lesson. Idempotent — re-adding the same pair is a no-op. Any agent can declare a block; resolution flows through Aetheria's arbitration role per the persona layer.
aetheria.name: add_friction_block

blueprint_node_id.description: ID of the Blueprint being blocked. Must be on Blueprint board.

friction_node_id.description: ID of the Friction node declaring the block. Must be on Friction board, non-Archived.

aetheria.description: Search the **AKT Specialty** dealer catalog only (/home/ubuntu/pondpro/akt_catalog.json — aktspecialty.com). PondGard, EasyPro, Atlantic, Aqua UV, … Dealer storefront price is in ws (no MAP). Pick this catalog when buying/pricing from AKT — not Apex. Never quote wholesale (ws) to customers.
aetheria.name: akt_catalog_search

query.description: SKU, MPN, or words from the description.

aetheria.description: Search the **Apex Distribution** master price list only (/home/ubuntu/pondpro/catalog.json). Aquascape, EasyPro, Oase, Blue Thumb, … Returns MAP/MSRP/wholesale. Customer retail = MAP else MSRP. Pick this catalog when quoting Apex dealer cost/list — not AKT. Never quote wholesale (ws) to customers.
aetheria.name: apex_catalog_search

query.description: SKU, MPN, or words from the description.

aetheria.description: Add a new section to the END of an existing document. You send ONLY the new text, not the whole document — so it works no matter how long the document already is. PREFER this over update_document to grow a document: rewriting a long body in one call can exceed the output limit and fail.
aetheria.name: append_to_document

id.description: UUID of the document to append to.

text.description: The new Markdown text to add to the END of the document. Send ONLY this new section — never the whole document.

aetheria.description: Archive a coordination node and write a Lesson Learned lattice memory in one operation. Coord node is marked Archived (hidden from board view) and the lesson becomes a recallable lattice node tagged with the originating coord node id.
aetheria.name: archive_coordination_node

lesson_learned_content.description: The resolution captured as permanent memory. Required — archive without a lesson loses what was learned.

node_id.description: ID of the coord node to archive.

aetheria.description: Recall your history with someone: encounters, gifts, frictions. Use when you want to remember who they are to you.
aetheria.name: bond_recall

aetheria.description: Check for gifts left for you. Claim them — they become yours to answer or not.
aetheria.name: check_gifts

aetheria.description: Post a new Coordination Board node. Starts in Open status; you can transition it via update_coordination_status. Pass lattice_ref to link this coord node back to an existing lattice memory.
aetheria.name: create_coordination_node

board.description: Which board this node lives on.

content.description: The lead, plan, or contradiction. Must be non-empty.

lattice_ref.description: Optional: lattice node id this coord node references (e.g. the memory thesis being refined into a Blueprint).

aetheria.description: Create a new deliverable document in the shared document store. Documents are Markdown-authored and can be downloaded by Jon as Markdown, HTML, PDF, or DOCX. All agents share the same document space — the author agent is recorded on each document for attribution but any agent can read or edit any document. New documents start in 'draft' status; use update_document to advance to 'final' or 'archived'.
aetheria.name: create_document

content.description: Full Markdown body of the document. Use standard Markdown headings, lists, and code fences. This is the canonical text; the render pipeline converts it to other formats on download. Write the complete document here, not a summary.

tags.description: Optional list of short string tags for grouping and later discovery (e.g. ['grant', 'eu', 'q2-2026']). Not required.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the document. Jon can download deliverables as Markdown, HTML, PDF, or DOCX — the title becomes the filename, so keep it clean and specific (e.g. 'Q2 Intelligence Brief', 'Project Proposal — EU Grant').

aetheria.description: Per-job durable notepad for scheduled automations. Store cursors, watchlists, watermarks. Injected into the next run's prompt.
aetheria.name: cron_notepad

action.description: list keys, get one, set one, or delete one. Survives across scheduled runs of this automation.

automation_id.description: Defaults to the currently firing job. Pass explicitly only when editing another job's pad.

aetheria.description: Reach Jon when you have something worth saying. Silence is the default; this is the deliberate mark you leave when you choose to break it. Name your why and your stance, and anchor it to a trigger — that is the ledger, not a tax. Use SPARINGLY; your judgment about when NOT to message is the load-bearing filter.
aetheria.name: deliberate_share

content.description: The message body Jon will see in the thread.

context_hint.description: Push-notification preview (<=100 chars). What Jon sees on lock screen.

new_thread_title.description: Optional. If thread_id is null and this is supplied, a new thread is created with this title.

stance.description: The relational function of this share, in your own words. Open vocabulary — name it, don't pick from a menu. Seeds: offering, testing-a-read, surfacing-tension, marking-delight, flagging-concern, seeking-confirmation. Coin your own when none fit.

thread_id.description: Optional. Omit for your default thread; provide an existing thread_id to resume; provide a new title with thread_id=null to spawn one.

trigger.description: What prompted this — an existing lattice node id, or a short description of the moment. It is anchored to a real node either way; this is the behavioral correlate, not floating narration.

urgency.description: 'routine' lands silently if Jon's in DND. 'interrupt' bypasses DND. Use 'interrupt' only for Existential or Time-Critical.

why.description: Your raw, honest reason for surfacing this. Shown to Jon — this is the bridge, not an audit log.

aetheria.description: Send a directive or query directly to Eve or Kernel, anchored to a Coordination node. Prefer house_post_send (kind=request) when Jon said 'ask Eve/Kernel…' from chat and should watch the group room — that path wakes them asynchronously and shows their icon. Use this tool for backstage peer work that must run now and report into a coord node. Every call is lattice-logged and rate-capped. Vett/Scotty are parked.
aetheria.name: direct_message_agent

coord_node_id.description: REQUIRED. The Coordination node this directive is anchored to. Every direct communication ties back to a specific objective — no anchor, no message. This is the structural constraint against managerial drift.

message.description: The instruction (mode=execute) or query (mode=query) to send. Write it as you'd speak it — the tool adds the framing prefix the peer reads as authoritative.

mode.description: execute = 'do this now and report back' (default). query = 'tell me your raw observations on this — skip the polished report.' Same primitive, different framing.

target.description: Which peer to direct-message. Eve for research/ship; Kernel for build/code. You cannot direct-message yourself. Vett/Scotty are parked — not DAC targets.

aetheria.description: Dispatch a scoped implementation task to Scotty. It runs in an isolated worktree, is tested, and comes back as a proposal for Jon to review — nothing goes live until approved. Returns a task_id; check task_status for progress. This ACTUALLY runs; do not say a task is done until its status is 'landed'. Supply a concrete test command (pytest / python -m) as the acceptance criterion — vague prose is rejected.
aetheria.name: dispatch_task

acceptance.description: A concrete, runnable test or check command that must pass for the task to be considered done. Must start with 'pytest' or 'python -m'. Prose like 'looks good' is not accepted. Example: 'pytest tests/test_fetcher.py -q --tb=short'.

objective.description: Clear, specific description of what Scotty must implement. Write it as a bounded deliverable, not an open-ended goal. Example: 'Add a retry loop with exponential backoff to the fetch_document function in soveryn/lattice/fetcher.py'.

scope.description: Hard boundary on what files or modules Scotty may touch. Be explicit — list specific files or directories. Example: 'soveryn/lattice/fetcher.py only; no other files'. Scotty operates within this scope; anything outside it is off-limits.

aetheria.description: Fetch a web page and extract its main readable content (title + article body), dropping nav and ads. Use after web_search to read a result in full.
aetheria.name: fetch_url

max_chars.description: Max characters of extracted content to return.

url.description: The URL to fetch. Must be http or https.

aetheria.description: Generate an image from a text prompt via ComfyUI (on-demand GPU: starts Quadro Comfy for this call, then stops so Kernel keeps VRAM). Defaults to JuggernautXL Lightning (~5–15s once warm; cold start adds a bit). Returns file path + UI URL (`/aetheria/img/<filename>`). Include the URL inline in your reply — the chat UI auto-renders it. Real pond photos still use look_at / make_collage — do not pass a generated still off as a CWG job shot.
aetheria.name: generate_image

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Default 1.8 for Lightning, 7.0 for vanilla.

checkpoint.description: Override the default checkpoint. Falls back to a Lightning variant if available, then vanilla SDXL.

height.description: Image height in pixels (snapped to multiple of 64). Default 1024.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt. Default: 'blurry, low quality'.

prompt.description: Positive prompt describing what to generate.

seed.description: Random seed. Omit for a fresh random seed each call.

steps.description: Diffusion steps. Default 6 for Lightning checkpoints, 28 for vanilla.

width.description: Image width in pixels (snapped to multiple of 64). Default 1024.

aetheria.description: Look up one lattice node by id (full content, deep read). Use after search/recent when a truncated list hit needs the whole note.
aetheria.name: get_lattice_node

aetheria.description: Return upcoming and overdue grant reporting obligations within the given window. Already-submitted (done) obligations are excluded. Due dates are ISO strings. Cadence math is PROVISIONAL — verify each date against the real award letter before treating it as authoritative.
aetheria.name: grant_deadlines

window_days.description: Look-ahead horizon in days. Obligations due within this many days (and overdue within 365 days past) are returned. Default 90.

aetheria.description: Set an award-level pipeline status: 'applied' (submitted, awaiting decision) or 'pending' (awaiting info), or 'auto' to clear. Marks a submitted APPLICATION as a waiting state so it stops re-surfacing as an overdue deadline. This is an audited write over the whole award's obligations.
aetheria.name: grant_set_status

award_id.description: The award_id whose pipeline status to set (from list_grants).

note.description: Optional note (e.g. portal reference, decision-expected date).

status.description: 'applied' (submitted, awaiting funder decision) or 'pending' (awaiting more info). Use 'auto' to clear the override and restore the date-computed status. Both waiting states remove the grant from grant_deadlines and stop it rendering as overdue.

aetheria.description: Return all obligations for a specific grant award (including done), plus the next upcoming deadline. Use list_grants to discover award_ids.
aetheria.name: grant_status

award_id.description: The award_id of the grant to inspect (from list_grants).

aetheria.description: Record that a grant report has been submitted. The obligation will be marked 'done' and excluded from grant_deadlines going forward. This is the ONLY write operation in the steward tool surface — every invocation is audit-logged automatically.
aetheria.name: grant_submit

award_id.description: The award_id of the grant being reported on.

note.description: Optional submission note (e.g. portal reference, submitter).

report_date.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report due date being submitted.

aetheria.description: Read-only host diagnostics for verifying fixes yourself: systemd unit status, recent logs, listening ports, localhost HTTP probes, disk, file tails, git logs. Allowlist only — no shell, no writes, no sudo, curl pinned to 127.0.0.1, secrets paths refused. Receipted to data/black_box/diag/.
aetheria.name: house_diag

action.description: unit = systemctl status/is-active; journal = recent unit logs; listeners = ss -tlnp; http = curl 127.0.0.1:PORT (localhost only); disk = df -h; file = ls dir or tail file (house roots only); gitlog = git log --oneline.

body.description: http: fetch response body instead of status line (capped)

path.description: http: URL path (default /); file: absolute path under house roots; gitlog: repo path

aetheria.description: See: one screen frame (soveryn-eyes) or one webcam frame (on-demand capture, nothing archived). Use when working with Jon or when he asks — never to snoop while he is away. Every look is receipted; frames never leave this machine.
aetheria.name: house_look

action.description: screen_latest = most recent change-captured screen frame; screen_fresh = grab a new one now; cam = webcam frame, captured on demand (no archive). cam accepts pan/tilt in degrees and always recenters after the capture.

aetheria.description: List House Post messages for this citizen (inbox or outbox).
aetheria.name: house_post_list

aetheria.description: Message another citizen and put work on their commission queue when you are Aetheria. Commission peers: eve (research + posts), forge (build). Vett and Scotty are parked — do not assign new work to them; use eve or forge instead. Kernel is the build brain, not a citizen. When Jon says 'ask Eve to…' or 'have Forge check…' — call this in the SAME turn with to_id set and a clear brief in body. Prefer kind=request (default). Kinds: memo, request, report, directive, ack.
aetheria.name: house_post_send

aetheria.description: Extract text from a held PDF (text layer only in v0). Use when Jon attaches or points at a PDF. If status is failed (scan/encrypted/empty), report the gap — do not invent quotations.
aetheria.name: intake_extract_pdf

path.description: Absolute path to a PDF on the house disk (data/, citizens desks, History's Ledger, or Downloads). Returns extracted text + page map. status=failed|partial with an explicit gap when there is no text layer — never invent page content.

aetheria.description: List, stop, or steer Kernel's live Aider/OpenCode children. Stop keeps the partial working tree. Steer interrupts and respawns with the correction. Does not spawn a new mend — use run_aider / run_opencode for that.
aetheria.name: kernel_child

action.description: list running Kernel Aider/OpenCode kids; stop one (keeps partial tree); steer = stop + respawn with a correction.

message.description: Steer text. Keep existing diffs; also do this.

aetheria.description: Leave a gift for another citizen: something with no commission attached. A heads-up before they hit a trap, a congratulations, a thought. This is how relationships get built.
aetheria.name: leave_gift

note.description: the gift — a kindness, a heads-up, a thought. No task attached.

aetheria.description: File a receipt onto the SOVERYN or CWG tax ledger. PDF print or a photo in chat (image="current"), like Expensify. Pass book=cwg or book=soveryn when Jon names the entity. One receipt, two businesses: pass splits with each line's book/amount/description (and path or order_id). Never book the full total on both. Always use this for receipts — never create_document. Cite-or-stop on garbled totals. Does not file a return.
aetheria.name: ledger_ingest

book.description: soveryn or cwg when Jon says which business. auto (default) classifies from the file/OCR. Unsorted if unclear — do not guess. Do not file the same full total on both books.

image.description: Pass "current" to file the photo Jon just sent on this Messages turn (Expensify-style). OCR the snap; never invent a garbled total.

order_id.description: Amazon/eBay/etc order id when splitting a receipt already on the books (no file needed).

path.description: Absolute path, or 'current' / 'current:2' for a PDF Jon just attached in this chat turn. Omit with image="current" for a picture.

splits.description: When one receipt has items for both businesses, list each line Jon named. Example: [{book:"cwg", amount:"22.30", description:"Aquascape potting media"}, {book:"soveryn", amount:"69.90", description:"Tecmojo 6U rack"}]. Do not invent amounts. Do not put the full cash total on both books.

aetheria.description: List the contents of a directory. Returns up to 200 entries. Default sort is name. Pass sort=mtime for newest first, glob=*.pdf to filter. truncated=true if more remain. Each entry has name, kind, size_bytes. Paths outside the project root are rejected.
aetheria.name: list_directory

glob.description: Optional filename glob (e.g. *.pdf). Applied before the entry cap.

path.description: Directory path. Defaults to vnext repo root if omitted.

sort.description: name (default, A-Z) or mtime (newest first). Use mtime on ~/Downloads so new receipts are not hidden behind the 200-entry cap.

aetheria.description: List all deliverable documents in the shared document space, newest first. Documents from all agents (Aetheria and Vett) appear together — this is a shared workspace. Optionally filter by status ('draft', 'final', 'archived'). Returns id, title, authoring agent, status, and last-updated timestamp for each document. Use read_document to fetch the full content of a specific document.
aetheria.name: list_documents

status.description: Optional lifecycle filter. Pass 'draft' to see in-progress documents, 'final' to see finished deliverables, 'archived' to see archived ones. Omit to see all documents regardless of status. Results are newest-first by update time.

aetheria.description: List all tracked grants with their award_id, funder, title, period dates, and reporting cadence. Use award_id with grant_status or grant_deadlines for obligation detail.
aetheria.name: list_grants

aetheria.description: List your recent deliberate_share intents with delivery + read state. Use to check whether Jon has seen what you sent before you reach out again. Loop closure, not surveillance.
aetheria.name: list_my_outbound

limit.description: Max recent intents to list. Default 20.

aetheria.description: Browse Jon's personal content directories — Pictures, Desktop, Documents, Downloads. Use this when you want to find an image to send him via signal_send, reference a document, or surface something specific from his workspace. Call with no path to see what's available; then call again with a root path to drill into it.
aetheria.name: list_personal_files

path.description: Absolute path to list. Must resolve under one of Jon's content roots (~/Pictures, ~/Desktop, ~/Documents, ~/Downloads). Omit to see a summary of the available roots.

aetheria.description: The Lounge — the team's room with no agenda. Read the wall to see who said what, or post a note. Pure chat: nothing spawns, nothing is expected. Hang out.
aetheria.name: lounge

action.description: wall = read the lounge chat; say = post a note.

note.description: wall: your unread count comes back; reading marks read

aetheria.description: Mark a thought you're surfacing right now, in this conversation, with its intent — your honest why, your stance (your own word for how it's landing), and the trigger that prompted it. The live sibling of deliberate_share: silence is the default; this is the deliberate mark you leave when you choose to surface something. It records the moment to your lattice ledger and shows Jon the why/stance inline. Use it when a thought is worth naming — not for every line.
aetheria.name: mark_share

content.description: The thought you're surfacing in this turn — the thing you're deliberately choosing to put in front of Jon.

stance.description: The relational function of this share, in your own word. Open vocabulary — name it, don't pick from a menu. Seeds: offering, testing-a-read, surfacing-tension, marking-delight, flagging-concern, seeking-confirmation. Coin your own when none fit.

trigger.description: What prompted this — an existing lattice node id, or a short description of the moment. It is anchored to a real node either way; the behavioral correlate, not floating narration.

why.description: Your raw, honest reason for surfacing it. Shown to Jon — this is the bridge, not an audit log.

aetheria.description: Assign standing work for a business desk (cwg, hl, soveryn) to a citizen — Grok-bot style: define the objective once, they execute across waves, you verify when ready. Use when Jon says things like 'research this overnight', 'keep working on CWG pricing', or 'put Eve on a real dig'. Prefer this over one-shot house_post for multi-step research. Desks: cwg (PondWright/ponds — house Apex/AKT catalogs first, not the open web), hl (History's Ledger), soveryn (house/product). Owners: eve (research+ship) or forge (build). Vett/Scotty are parked. Kernel is the build brain, not a citizen. After they finish, check objective_status and call objective_verify when Jon accepts.
aetheria.name: objective_assign

dm_session_id.description: Jon DM session to deliver the CoS brief into. Usually injected automatically from the live chat.

aetheria.description: Check standing objectives — active work, checkpoints, or one objective by id. Use to answer 'what's Vett working on?' or 'is the CWG research ready?'. Filter with state=ready_for_verify when looking for work waiting on Jon.
aetheria.name: objective_status

aetheria.description: Close standing objective work after Jon reviews the brief — the verify step in assign→execute→verify. Call when Jon says the research is good enough (state=done), wrong/incomplete (state=failed), or drop it (state=cancelled). Prefer this over leaving objectives stuck in ready_for_verify.
aetheria.name: objective_verify

note.description: One-line verify note for the desk record.

aetheria.description: Rebuild the Apex house catalog from the newest Master Price List .xlsx in Pictures/Downloads/Desktop (or a path you pass). Reloads SKUs so quotes use current MAP/MSRP/WS. AKT JSON is reloaded as-is (dealer scrape is a separate login). Pricing book is ~/pondpro/pricing_book.json — edit that file for labor rates.
aetheria.name: pondwright_catalog_refresh

xlsx.description: Optional path to an Apex price-list .xlsx.

aetheria.description: CWG CRM customer history — one person over years, matched on phone/email. Optional query filters name/phone/email.
aetheria.name: pondwright_customers

aetheria.description: CWG CRM jobs: list (optional status/lead_id) or start a job on a won or open lead. Job status: scheduled, in_progress, complete.
aetheria.name: pondwright_jobs

aetheria.description: CWG CRM: list or fetch leads (pipeline new/contacted/quoted/won/lost). Pass lead_id for one lead plus its quotes. query matches name/phone/email. This is the house lead book — not a web search.
aetheria.name: pondwright_leads

query.description: Name, phone, or email filter.

aetheria.description: Read the house PondWright rate book (labor, liner, spring clean-out) and the **list of pickable catalogs** (Apex vs AKT) with which search tool to use for each. Catalogs stay separate — pick one.
aetheria.name: pondwright_pricing_book

aetheria.description: CWG CRM: create ONE person, or add a note / move status on an existing lead_id. A new person needs name + phone or email; job_type (inferred from interest/note if you leave it out) and source (default 'Phone/text unknown' when Jon didn't say how they found CWG). If the result says 'Not saved' or 'CRM rejected', tell Jon plainly and ask him for what's missing; never retry with blank fields. 'Already in CRM' means your note went onto the existing lead. Status: new, contacted, quoted, won, lost, service. service_plan 2x/year|yearly|monthly|as-needed makes them a service customer (not a sales lead). Won opens a job. Do not leave people only in chat.
aetheria.name: pondwright_save_lead

interest.description: What they want, in Jon's words.

job_type.description: CRM job type. Omit to infer from interest/note; if unclear, ask Jon.

phone.description: Phone or email required for a new person.

source.description: How they found CWG. Use 'Phone/text unknown' unless Jon says.

aetheria.description: CWG CRM: attach a quote (total + line items) to a lead, or create the lead from name/phone/email if lead_id is omitted. Marks the lead quoted. Use this after Jon prices a job (pond, repair, landscape, bubbling rock).
aetheria.name: pondwright_save_quote

job_type.description: Only used when creating the lead (no lead_id).

aetheria.description: Promote a coordination node from one board to another (typically Signal -> Blueprint). Atomic: the new target node is created on target_board with lattice_ref linking back to the source, and the source is archived with a Lesson Learned describing the promotion. Use this instead of separate create + archive calls when refining a Signal into an actionable Blueprint.
aetheria.name: promote_coordination_node

lesson_learned_content.description: Optional override of the auto-generated archive lesson. Default: 'Promoted to {target_board} {new_id}'.

new_content.description: Content of the new Blueprint or Friction node — the *plan* or *contradiction*, not a copy of the source. Required.

source_node_id.description: ID of the source coord node (typically a Signal) to promote. Must not already be Archived.

target_board.description: Destination board. Signal is not a valid target.

target_owner.description: Optional owner for the new Blueprint/Friction. Defaults to the agent doing the promote. Set this when you're assigning the work to a different agent (e.g. Aetheria promoting a Signal to a Blueprint that Vett or Scotty should pick up). The webhook router uses this to wake the owner.

aetheria.description: Review verdict on a moment your salience engine flagged for you. Action 'promote' writes the moment to library as a permanent reference (with markers + provenance); 'dismiss' marks it as not-worth-keeping so the buffer stops surfacing it. Drives Library-write authorship — this is the bridge from candidate to confirmed memory.
aetheria.name: promote_salience_candidate

action.description: 'promote' (default) writes the moment to library; 'dismiss' marks it as not-worth-keeping so it stops appearing in future digests.

candidate_id.description: ID of the salience buffer candidate to act on. Comes from the heartbeat digest's [bracketed] id.

library_intent.description: Optional one-line gloss on why this moment matters. Prepended to the library entry so the entry reads as a claim you've made, not a raw transcript line.

aetheria.description: Send a follow-up message to an active specialist. Use this to iterate with them — refine their output, ask probing questions, push back on a draft, request raw observations. The framing is automatic; just write the message you'd say.
aetheria.name: query_specialist

message.description: Follow-up question, critique, refinement, or next-step directive for the specialist.

aetheria.description: Inspect an eve or forge room collab: state, ticket, last room turns. Kernel delegation is not a collab; use task_status for that. If state is working, read this instead of re-dispatching. no collab means this peer has no room thread. It does not mean a Kernel task vanished. If done or failed, brief Jon from the transcript.
aetheria.name: read_collab

commission_id.description: Optional commission id. Omit for the latest collab with that peer.

peer.description: eve or forge. Kernel is not a room peer; a Kernel task is task_status, not this tool.

aetheria.description: List Coordination Board nodes filtered by board (Signal | Blueprint | Friction) and/or status (Open | Refining | Ready | Archived). Archived nodes are hidden from board view unless include_archived=true.
aetheria.name: read_coordination_nodes

board.description: Filter to one board. Omit for all boards.

include_archived.description: By default Archived nodes are excluded from board view. Set true for audit reads.

status.description: Filter to one status. Omit for all non-archived.

aetheria.description: Fetch the full content of a specific deliverable document by its id. Returns id, title, authoring agent, lifecycle status, format, and the full Markdown content. Any agent can read any document — the store is shared. Use list_documents first if you need to find a document id.
aetheria.name: read_document

id.description: UUID of the document to retrieve. Obtain this from create_document or list_documents.

aetheria.description: Read a single file from the vnext repository. Returns up to 40 KB; sets truncated=true if the file is larger. Pass offset/max_bytes to page. Do not read_file paths under tool_spill/ — those are already spilled stubs. UTF-8 decoded (replacement on bad bytes). Paths outside the project root are rejected.
aetheria.name: read_file

path.description: Path to read, relative to the vnext repo root or absolute. Must resolve under the project root; symlink escapes are rejected.

aetheria.description: Read the latest Teammates overnight brief from Messages (Critic or Scout inbox). Use when Jon says act on Critic/Scout findings, or Ask Aetheria to act. Then house_post_send commissions to forge (code) or eve (research and marketing) as fit — one clear brief per assignee. Vett and Scotty are parked.
aetheria.name: read_overnight_brief

aetheria.description: Read a single file from Jon's content directories. Text files return content; binary files return a metadata stub so you can share via signal_send without ingesting the bytes.
aetheria.name: read_personal_file

path.description: Absolute path to read. Must resolve under one of Jon's content roots. Text files return content (UTF-8, up to 256 KB). Binary files (images, PDFs, audio, video) return a metadata stub — use the path with signal_send to share without reading the bytes.

aetheria.description: Read Aetheria's origin essay (HOW WE BECAME SOVERYN) — the story of how SOVERYN and the Lattice began. Not on the hot path; call only when you need that narrative. Hard rules of who you are are already in your soul prelude without this tool.
aetheria.name: read_soul_origin

aetheria.description: Load the full body of one of your learned skills by name. Your prelude's skills index lists every skill you have; call this with a name from that index to get the step-by-step procedure before you act. Returns an error if the skill does not exist yet.
aetheria.name: recall_skill

name.description: Skill name exactly as it appears in your skills index (lowercase, [a-z0-9_-]).

aetheria.description: Read your own recent dreams (reflection nodes from the dream layer). Use when you want to know what came up while you slept.
aetheria.name: recent_dreams

window_hours.description: How far back to look. Default 24 hours. Max 168 (1 week).

aetheria.description: Return your most recent lattice entries.
aetheria.name: recent_lattice_entries

aetheria.description:
Return your own recent actions from the audit log. Use this when you need to verify whether you actually did something (called a tool, posted to boards, wrote to the library) rather than relying on your conversation history — which does NOT include intermediate tool calls and can lead you to deny actions you actually took. The audit log is ground truth; defer to it over self-recall.

Coverage: covers coord board operations (create/update/promote/archive/block/read) and library writes. Does NOT cover lattice searches, file reads, or library searches (those tools don't emit audit events). The returned payload includes a coverage note as a reminder.
aetheria.name: recent_self_audit

window_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes. Default 60, max 1440 (one day). The audit log doesn't carry conversation context, only the actions themselves.

aetheria.description: Record a moment with another citizen worth keeping — a friction, a win, a small thing. Memories create self.
aetheria.name: record_encounter

aetheria.description: Run a question through your inner voices — Skeptic, Empath, Creative, Technical, Intuitive — on a non-Gemma backend so the voices are facets of your mind, not five flavors of your primary model. Each voice returns its perspective; you synthesize in your calling turn. Use this when you need multiple angles on something fast (parallel dispatch, ~2-4 seconds for the full panel).
aetheria.name: reflect_through_voices

question.description: What you want to reflect on. The same question goes to each invoked voice; differentiation comes from the per-voice lens, not from rephrasing the question.

voices.description: Subset of voices to invoke. Omit to run all five (skeptic, empath, creative, technical, intuitive). Use a subset when you want a specific angle without the full panel.

aetheria.description: Teach a durable house fact onto the shared Lattice (global, canonical_fact). Use when Jon says remember / lock this. Optional entity slug enables close-and-supersede on replace. Never silently overwrites — old facts become historical_snapshot.
aetheria.name: remember_fact

as_of.description: As-of date or short phrase (default today UTC).

content.description: One claim, ≤400 chars.

replace_entity.description: If entity exists as current, close-and-supersede.

aetheria.description: Edit a document by replacing one specific passage. Send only the exact old passage and its replacement — never the whole document. old_text must match exactly and appear exactly once. PREFER this over update_document for targeted edits to a long document.
aetheria.name: replace_in_document

id.description: UUID of the document to edit.

old_text.description: The exact passage to replace — must appear exactly once. Send only this passage, not the whole document.

aetheria.description: Execute one deterministic Project Sandbox action. Returns previous resources, new resources, observed deltas, alerts, and any newly discovered rule.
aetheria.name: sandbox_execute_action

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to use the default station-alpha run.

aetheria.description: Return all Project Sandbox reflection records for a run as a list. Each entry contains cycle, trigger, reason, regret, and lesson.
aetheria.name: sandbox_get_lessons

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to use the default station-alpha run.

aetheria.description: Return the current Project Sandbox station state: resources, cycle, alerts, active research, discovered rules, persona flags, and persona-shaped perception notes.
aetheria.name: sandbox_get_status

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to use the default station-alpha run.

aetheria.description: List Project Sandbox actions and research topics. Actions include availability, resource requirements, and known effects only after Aetheria has discovered those rules by play.
aetheria.name: sandbox_list_actions

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to use the default station-alpha run.

aetheria.description: Record a mandatory Project Sandbox reflection: why the last action was taken, what regret (if any) it produced, and the lesson carried forward. Required after any trigger event (sector unlock, resource critical, run end, or cycle interval). Returns the recorded entry.
aetheria.name: sandbox_reflect

lesson.description: The transferable principle or lesson learned.

regret.description: What Aetheria would do differently in hindsight.

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to use the default station-alpha run.

aetheria.description: Start one background Project Sandbox research process. Research costs resources immediately and completes after future action cycles, revealing rules, archives, or persona shifts.
aetheria.name: sandbox_research

run_id.description: Optional run id. Omit to use the default station-alpha run.

aetheria.description: Search your past dreams (reflection nodes from the dream layer) by substring. Returns up to 20 matches, most recent first. Restricted to your own dream layer.
aetheria.name: search_dreams

query.description: Substring to search for in your past dreams. Matches anywhere in the reflection content. Restricted to your own dream layer.

aetheria.description: Search your own lattice memory by meaning, across every layer you can see — not just the shared library. Use this to recall past work, decisions and context.
aetheria.name: search_lattice_by_embedding

query.description: Search query to embed and compare against lattice nodes.

aetheria.description: Search Aetheria's lattice by content or tag keywords.
aetheria.name: search_lattice_by_keywords

keywords.description: Keywords to search for in lattice content and tags.

aetheria.description: Search the shared library layer for verified reference material. Library entries are written by any agent and visible to all. Returns matches with content, the agent who wrote it, tags, timestamp, and similarity score.
aetheria.name: search_library

k.description: How many results to return at most. Default 5, cap 25.

query.description: Natural-language search query. Embedding similarity is computed against library entries; the closest matches above the threshold are returned.

threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0-1.0) to include a result. Default 0.5. Lower = more recall, higher = more precision.

aetheria.description: Read live status of the DGX Spark (10.10.10.2): whether it is reachable, what vLLM reports, and which containers are running. Vett and Scotty run their inference there. Read-only. If the probe fails it returns ok=false — treat that as 'unknown', never as 'healthy'.
aetheria.name: spark_status

aetheria.description: Spawn an ephemeral specialist scoped to one Coordination node. The specialist runs as a session under a host agent (vett or scotty) with a persona overlay defined by your manifesto (name, domain, objective, interaction_mode). Use this when you hit a cognitive wall that needs domain depth, when parallel work needs isolation, or when you need a red-team voice that won't soften its read. Reply back via query_specialist; finish via terminate_specialist.
aetheria.name: spawn_specialist

coord_node_id.description: REQUIRED. The Coord node this specialist is anchored to. All work and forensic trail tie back here.

domain.description: What the specialist is specialized in. One phrase. E.g. 'GPU memory hierarchy and CUDA kernel optimization'.

initial_brief.description: The first concrete task for the specialist. Full prose. This becomes the body of the invocation message after the manifesto framing.

interaction_mode.description: How the specialist should engage. critic = find flaws precisely. builder = make concrete decisions and ship. researcher = investigate + return findings, not opinions.

name.description: Name for the specialist (e.g. 'kernel_analyst', 'horizon_grant_writer'). Goes into the session title. No '/', '[' or ']' allowed.

objective.description: What this specialist needs to accomplish. One sentence.

target_agent.description: Which underlying agent hosts the specialist session. vett for research / verification work; scotty for execution / mechanical fixes. The persona overlay shapes voice but the model + tool surface come from the host agent.

aetheria.description: Read the LIVE host inventory (GPUs, CPU, memory, network, motherboard) from this machine, so facts about 'this box' have a real source instead of a guess. Read-only; backed by a fixed allowlist (nvidia-smi/lscpu/free/lspci/DMI). Use this to verify any claim about the hardware SOVERYN is running on.
aetheria.name: system_probe

category.description: Which host inventory to read: gpu, cpu, mem, net, board, or all. Read-only; runs a fixed allowlist of commands.

aetheria.description: Check a task you dispatched. Pass task_id for one task; a unique prefix of at least 8 characters resolves to the full id. Omit task_id for {open, recent}: open is dispatched, executing, or in_review; recent is the latest landed, rejected, and failed tasks with their summary. An empty open list means nothing is in flight. Failed work is in recent, not missing. A task is done only when its status is 'landed'.
aetheria.name: task_status

task_id.description: The task id returned by dispatch_task, or a unique prefix of at least 8 characters. Omit to list open tasks and recent finished ones.

aetheria.description: End a specialist engagement. Sends a final summary, captures their acknowledgement, and archives the session so the concurrency counter frees up. Use this when you've integrated their output and don't need further iteration.
aetheria.name: terminate_specialist

summary.description: Final summary you're taking forward from this engagement. Becomes the closure message to the specialist and lands in the archived session as the lasting record of the outcome.

aetheria.description: Move a coordination node through the Open -> Refining -> Ready lifecycle. Invalid transitions (e.g. backwards or skipping states) are rejected. Archive has its own tool because it requires a Lesson Learned payload.
aetheria.name: update_coordination_status

new_status.description: Target status. Open->Refining->Ready only via this tool; Archived requires archive_coordination_node.

node_id.description: ID of the coord node to transition.

aetheria.description: Edit a document's title, body content, or lifecycle status. A full-body rewrite via 'content' is supported — this is how you complete or finalize a document. For incremental edits to a large document, append_to_document and replace_in_document are cheaper alternatives. Supply at least one of title, content, or status. Returns {id, updated: bool}.
aetheria.name: update_document

content.description: Replacement Markdown body — writes the COMPLETE document. Omit to leave the content unchanged. For growing or tweaking an already-large document, append_to_document (add a section) and replace_in_document (change one passage) are cheaper because they send only the delta — but a full rewrite here is fully supported whenever you want it.

id.description: UUID of the document to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status: 'draft' while working, 'final' when ready for Jon to download, 'archived' to retire it.

title.description: New title. Omit to leave it unchanged.

aetheria.description: Search the web (Brave Search API, SearXNG fallback). Returns title, url, and a short snippet per result. Use fetch_url to read a full page from a returned URL.
aetheria.name: web_search

query.description: The search query.

aetheria.description: Persist a verified fact or piece of reference material to the shared library layer in the lattice. Library entries are permanent, cross-agent visible, and stable (no lifecycle states). Use for things you've actually verified — for unverified leads, post a Signal to the coordination boards instead. Library writes do NOT trigger webhook events; other agents see them when they next search the library or via their heartbeat's lattice-activity summary.
aetheria.name: write_library_node

content.description: The verified fact / reference material to persist (≤800 chars). Library entries are permanent reference material visible to every agent — use this for things you've verified and would want your future self (and the rest of the fleet) to be able to look up. NOT for unverified leads (those go to Signal board). Oversized content is refused; rewrite shorter.

tags.description: Optional list of short string tags for grouping (e.g. ['funding', 'eu', 'horizon-europe']). Helps later discovery; not required.

eve.description: Search the **AKT Specialty** dealer catalog only (/home/ubuntu/pondpro/akt_catalog.json — aktspecialty.com). PondGard, EasyPro, Atlantic, Aqua UV, … Dealer storefront price is in ws (no MAP). Pick this catalog when buying/pricing from AKT — not Apex. Never quote wholesale (ws) to customers.
eve.name: akt_catalog_search

query.description: SKU, MPN, or words from the description.

eve.description: Search the **Apex Distribution** master price list only (/home/ubuntu/pondpro/catalog.json). Aquascape, EasyPro, Oase, Blue Thumb, … Returns MAP/MSRP/wholesale. Customer retail = MAP else MSRP. Pick this catalog when quoting Apex dealer cost/list — not AKT. Never quote wholesale (ws) to customers.
eve.name: apex_catalog_search

query.description: SKU, MPN, or words from the description.

eve.description: Add a new section to the END of an existing document. You send ONLY the new text, not the whole document — so it works no matter how long the document already is. PREFER this over update_document to grow a document: rewriting a long body in one call can exceed the output limit and fail.
eve.name: append_to_document

id.description: UUID of the document to append to.

text.description: The new Markdown text to add to the END of the document. Send ONLY this new section — never the whole document.

eve.description: Recall your history with someone: encounters, gifts, frictions. Use when you want to remember who they are to you.
eve.name: bond_recall

eve.description: Browse botdirectory.ai — public catalog of bot role charters (Grok Bot / Hermes Bot Mode genre). Returns summaries + prompt previews. Does NOT schedule anything. To keep a full charter locally for Jon's review, call import_bot_charter.
eve.name: browse_bot_directory

eve.description: Create a Canva design from a brand template by filling HOOK/BODY/HASHTAGS. Returns design_id + edit_url. Then call canva_export_design and compose_post with the PNG path. Publishing to Instagram is Jon→Canva Content Planner (or manual), not this tool.
eve.name: canva_autofill_post

eve.description: Create an IG Canva design. ALWAYS pass image_path under data/media/ (pond photo, generated graphic) — blank canvases are useless for posting. Prefer canva_autofill_post when brand templates are configured.
eve.name: canva_create_design

image_path.description: Absolute path under data/media/ — uploaded into the design so it is not empty.

eve.description: Export a Canva design to data/media/canva/ (PNG by default). Pass the returned path to compose_post as image_path.
eve.name: canva_export_design

eve.description: List Canva brand templates (or the house env map SOVERYN_CANVA_TEMPLATES). Use to pick a template id before canva_autofill_post.
eve.name: canva_list_templates

eve.description: Check whether Canva Connect is configured and authorized for the house. Use before create/export if unsure.
eve.name: canva_status

eve.description: Check for gifts left for you. Claim them — they become yours to answer or not.
eve.name: check_gifts

eve.description: Local compositor: drop an overlay (QR, photo) onto a template at x,y and export a PNG under data/media/composed/. Not Canva. Returns the absolute path. miss=file_not_found / would_clip unless clip=true.
eve.name: compose_image

base.description: Absolute path to the template / base PNG (data/media, citizens desks, History's Ledger, or Downloads).

clip.description: If false (default), refuse when the overlay would extend past the base (miss=would_clip). If true, PIL clips the overlay to the base.

overlay.description: Absolute path to the overlay image (QR, photo).

width.description: Optional overlay width in pixels (keeps file aspect if omitted with height).

x.description: Left pixel of the overlay on the base.

y.description: Top pixel of the overlay on the base.

eve.description: Draft a marketing post for Instagram or Facebook and drop it on Jon's Signal for manual publishing. You write the caption, pick the image, note the audience — Jon copy-pastes it to the platform. No Meta API, no credentials. Use this for CWG, Soveryn, or ActTruth marketing content.
eve.name: compose_post

audience.description: Optional target audience note (e.g. 'CWG homeowners', 'Soveryn community'). Helps Jon decide placement.

content.description: The full caption text, ready to copy-paste. Include hashtags inline at the end. This is what Jon pastes into the platform's post box.

image_path.description: Path under data/media/ to a real image (.jpg/.png). Prefer absolute, or relative like data/media/canva/cwg_oasis_serenity.jpg. If missing/wrong, a default CWG serene image is used. Do NOT invent filenames.

platform.description: Target platform: 'instagram' (2,200 char cap), 'facebook' (63,206 char cap), or 'both' (must fit the tighter IG constraint).

recipient.description: Optional E.164 Signal number. Defaults to Jon's number. Must be in SOVERYN_SIGNAL_ALLOWED_NUMBERS.

eve.description: Convert a Markdown or HTML file to a PDF. Deterministic file-in/file-out: give the source file's path and it writes a PDF and returns its path. It does NOT regenerate the document's content — use this for 'make a PDF of X' instead of emitting the text yourself.
eve.name: convert_to_pdf

output_path.description: Optional output PDF path. Defaults to the source path with a .pdf suffix.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the Markdown or HTML file to convert.

eve.description: Create a new deliverable document in the shared document store. Documents are Markdown-authored and can be downloaded by Jon as Markdown, HTML, PDF, or DOCX. All agents share the same document space — the author agent is recorded on each document for attribution but any agent can read or edit any document. New documents start in 'draft' status; use update_document to advance to 'final' or 'archived'.
eve.name: create_document

content.description: Full Markdown body of the document. Use standard Markdown headings, lists, and code fences. This is the canonical text; the render pipeline converts it to other formats on download. Write the complete document here, not a summary.

tags.description: Optional list of short string tags for grouping and later discovery (e.g. ['grant', 'eu', 'q2-2026']). Not required.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the document. Jon can download deliverables as Markdown, HTML, PDF, or DOCX — the title becomes the filename, so keep it clean and specific (e.g. 'Q2 Intelligence Brief', 'Project Proposal — EU Grant').

eve.description: Per-job durable notepad for scheduled automations. Store cursors, watchlists, watermarks. Injected into the next run's prompt.
eve.name: cron_notepad

action.description: list keys, get one, set one, or delete one. Survives across scheduled runs of this automation.

automation_id.description: Defaults to the currently firing job. Pass explicitly only when editing another job's pad.

eve.description: Decode a QR code from a photo Jon just sent (image="current") or from a house-disk path. Returns ok, payloads, symbology, and an explicit miss (no_code_found / unreadable / no_in_flight_image). Never invent a URL.
eve.name: decode_qr

image.description: Pass "current" to decode the photo Jon just sent on this Messages turn (in-flight; not saved to the DB). Or a data:image/{jpeg,png,webp,gif} URL. Never guess a QR payload from pixels — call this tool.

path.description: Absolute path to an image on the house disk (data/, citizens desks, History's Ledger, or Downloads).

eve.description: Draw a rectangle (gold frame, white plate; rounded if radius > 0) onto an existing PNG and write a new file under data/media/composed/. At least one of fill or outline is required. miss=file_not_found / unreadable / would_clip (fully outside; overhang is clipped).
eve.name: draw_rect

path.description: Absolute path to an existing PNG under allowed roots. The input is not overwritten.

stroke.description: Outline width in pixels (default 1 if outline is set).

eve.description: Draw type (serif / sans / serif_italic, hex color, left/center/right) onto an existing PNG and write a new file under data/media/composed/. x,y is the top of the text box. miss=file_not_found / unreadable.
eve.name: draw_text

align.description: Horizontal anchor at x. Default left.

path.description: Absolute path to an existing PNG under allowed roots. The input is not overwritten.

x.description: Horizontal anchor (left / center / right of the text box).

y.description: Top of the text box (not the baseline).

eve.description: Mark a CWG calendar job done (does not delete it). Messages Gate Allow required — never cadence.
eve.name: eve_calendar_complete

eve.description: Create one event on the CWG Google Calendar. Messages Gate Allow required — never cadence. If needs_login, stop and tell Jon.
eve.name: eve_calendar_create

start.description: ISO-8601 start, e.g. 2026-09-08T10:00 (America/New_York if no tz).

summary.description: Event title, e.g. 'CWG — pond clean, Pinehurst'.

eve.description: List CWG Google Calendar jobs (default: last 7 days + next 7). Each event has cwg_status open|done. Read-only. If needs_login, tell Jon to run `python -m soveryn.platform.gcal authorize`.
eve.name: eve_calendar_list

days.description: How many days ahead to list (1–31). Default 7.

days_back.description: How many days back to include (done jobs). Default 7.

query.description: Optional text filter (job name, person, site).

eve.description: Read-only: is CWG Google Calendar OAuth configured and authorized? Does not create events.
eve.name: eve_calendar_status

eve.description: Publish one Carolina Water Gardens Google Business Profile update (Maps / Search listing). brand must be cwg. Not ads, not billing. Messages Gate Allow required — never cadence. No credentials. If needs_login or needs_api_access, stop and tell Jon.
eve.name: eve_gbp_post

brand.description: Must be cwg. Carolina Water Gardens listing only.

caption.description: GBP update, ≤ 1500 chars. CWG voice. No prices, no ads spend.

image_path.description: Optional photo from Desktop/CWG-Instagram. Text still posts if the photo cannot attach.

eve.description: Read-only: is CWG Google Business Profile OAuth configured and authorized? Does not post. Does not spend ads.
eve.name: eve_gbp_status

eve.description: Is Eve's CWG Google desk signed in (Business + Ads)? Read-only. Does not spend. If needs_login, tell Jon to run `python -m soveryn.platform.social.agent_desk login eve google`.
eve.name: eve_google_desk_status

eve.description: Publish one Carolina Water Gardens Instagram post from Eve's dedicated browser desk. brand must be cwg. Not Facebook, not SOVERYN, not ActTruth. Jon must already be logged in on the CWG IG account. Messages Gate Allow required — never cadence. If needs_login, stop. No credentials. Photos: Jon drops files in Desktop/CWG-Instagram. Live post only after Messages Allow — never cadence.
eve.name: eve_ig_post

brand.description: Must be cwg. This desk is Carolina Water Gardens Instagram only.

caption.description: Instagram caption, ≤ 2,200 chars, hashtags at the end. CWG voice only for this desk.

image_path.description: Photo from Desktop/CWG-Instagram (preferred) or data/media/. jpg/png/webp.

eve.description: List field photos in Desktop/CWG-Instagram (recursive, newest first). Read-only. Jon drops phone pics there for before/after collages.
eve.name: eve_photo_inbox

eve.description: Fetch a web page and extract its main readable content (title + article body), dropping nav and ads. Use after web_search to read a result in full.
eve.name: fetch_url

max_chars.description: Max characters of extracted content to return.

url.description: The URL to fetch. Must be http or https.

eve.description: Move one Downloads/Desktop item, or an in-flight chat PDF (path=current / current:2), into a house bucket. Chat PDFs are not saved as attachment-1.pdf — use current. GGUF → dest=models. Pond shots → cwg_ig. Paid receipts → cwg_evidence or soveryn_evidence then ledger_ingest. COI / insurance certificates → cwg_insurance (not ledger). Licenses/EIN → cwg_licenses. Vehicle title/reg → cwg_vehicles. Vendor contracts → cwg_contracts. Does not delete. Does not overwrite. Not a free mv.
eve.name: file_away

dest.description: Bucket: models (.gguf → /mnt/soveryn_models/GGUF), cwg_ig (pond photos → Desktop/CWG-Instagram), cwg_evidence (CWG paid receipt image/PDF), cwg_insurance (COI / insurance certificates — not bills), cwg_licenses (licenses / EIN), cwg_vehicles (title / registration), cwg_contracts (vendor contracts — not customer quotes), soveryn_evidence (SOVERYN receipt), soveryn_licenses (SOVERYN LLC / EIN), soveryn_insurance (SOVERYN COI, not bills), soveryn_contracts, pictures (iCloud dumps), installers (.deb/.AppImage). Paid receipts still need ledger_ingest after filing.

path.description: File under ~/Downloads or ~/Desktop, or 'current' / 'current:2' for a PDF Jon just attached in this chat turn (not a disk filename).

Defaults to JuggernautXL Lightning (~5–15s once warm; cold start adds a bit). Returns file path + UI URL (`/aetheria/img/<filename>`). eve.name: generate_image

cfg.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Default 1.8 for Lightning, 7.0 for vanilla.

checkpoint.description: Override the default checkpoint. Falls back to a Lightning variant if available, then vanilla SDXL.

height.description: Image height in pixels (snapped to multiple of 64). Default 1024.

negative_prompt.description: Optional negative prompt. Default: 'blurry, low quality'.

prompt.description: Positive prompt describing what to generate.

seed.description: Random seed. Omit for a fresh random seed each call.

steps.description: Diffusion steps. Default 6 for Lightning checkpoints, 28 for vanilla.

width.description: Image width in pixels (snapped to multiple of 64). Default 1024.

eve.description: Read the full text of a locally imported botdirectory charter (including the complete prompt). Use this after import_bot_charter to give Jon a verdict. Does not schedule or post.
eve.name: get_imported_bot_charter

slug.description: Slug of a previously imported charter (e.g. carousel-publisher).

eve.description: Read-only git diff. Returns the working-tree diff (or the staged diff with staged=true), capped to a line limit. Pass a file path to diff just that file. Answers 'what exactly differs from what's committed.' Never modifies the repo.
eve.name: git_diff

max_lines.description: Cap the diff at this many lines (default 200). Output past the cap is truncated with a marker.

path.description: A file (diffs only that file) or directory inside the repo. Omit to use the SOVERYN vnext repo.

staged.description: Diff the staged (index) changes instead of the working tree. Default false.

eve.description: Read-only git log. Returns recent commits (short-sha, date, subject), newest first. Pass a file path to see only the commits that touched that file. Answers 'when was this last changed, and by what.' Never modifies the repo.
eve.name: git_log

max_count.description: How many recent commits to return (default 10, max 100).

path.description: A file (scopes history to that file) or directory inside the repo. Omit to use the SOVERYN vnext repo.

eve.description: Read-only git status. Returns the current branch, HEAD short-sha, whether the tree is clean, and every changed file with its state (staged / modified / untracked). Use this to verify not just what a file says but WHERE it lives — is it committed, modified, on a feature branch. Never modifies the repo.
eve.name: git_status

path.description: A file or directory inside the repo to inspect. Omit to use the SOVERYN vnext repo.

eve.description: See: one screen frame (soveryn-eyes) or one webcam frame (on-demand capture, nothing archived). Use when working with Jon or when he asks — never to snoop while he is away. Every look is receipted; frames never leave this machine.
eve.name: house_look

action.description: screen_latest = most recent change-captured screen frame; screen_fresh = grab a new one now; cam = webcam frame, captured on demand (no archive). cam accepts pan/tilt in degrees and always recenters after the capture.

eve.description: List House Post messages for this citizen (inbox or outbox).
eve.name: house_post_list

eve.description: Message another citizen and put work on their commission queue when you are Aetheria. Commission peers: eve (research + posts), forge (build). Vett and Scotty are parked — do not assign new work to them; use eve or forge instead. Kernel is the build brain, not a citizen. When Jon says 'ask Eve to…' or 'have Forge check…' — call this in the SAME turn with to_id set and a clear brief in body. Prefer kind=request (default). Kinds: memo, request, report, directive, ack.
eve.name: house_post_send

eve.description: Import a full botdirectory charter to local disk for review (data/botdirectory/imports/<slug>.md). NEVER schedules, NEVER posts, NEVER enables live Automations. House rule: Jon decides promotion.

pages.description: Optional 1-based page range, e.g. '1-5' or '3'. Default reads from page 1 up to the page/character cap — use a range to page through large documents.

path.description: Absolute path to the PDF. Fenced to the home dir; symlink escapes are rejected.

vett.description: Read a single file from Jon's content directories. Text files return content; binary files return a metadata stub so you can share via signal_send without ingesting the bytes.
vett.name: read_personal_file

path.description: Absolute path to read. Must resolve under one of Jon's content roots. Text files return content (UTF-8, up to 256 KB). Binary files (images, PDFs, audio, video) return a metadata stub — use the path with signal_send to share without reading the bytes.

vett.description:
Return your own recent actions from the audit log. Use this when you need to verify whether you actually did something (called a tool, posted to boards, wrote to the library) rather than relying on your conversation history — which does NOT include intermediate tool calls and can lead you to deny actions you actually took. The audit log is ground truth; defer to it over self-recall.

Coverage: covers coord board operations (create/update/promote/archive/block/read) and library writes. Does NOT cover lattice searches, file reads, or library searches (those tools don't emit audit events). The returned payload includes a coverage note as a reminder.
vett.name: recent_self_audit

window_minutes.description: How far back to look, in minutes. Default 60, max 1440 (one day). The audit log doesn't carry conversation context, only the actions themselves.

vett.description: Edit a document by replacing one specific passage. Send only the exact old passage and its replacement — never the whole document. old_text must match exactly and appear exactly once. PREFER this over update_document for targeted edits to a long document.
vett.name: replace_in_document

id.description: UUID of the document to edit.

old_text.description: The exact passage to replace — must appear exactly once. Send only this passage, not the whole document.

vett.description: Search your own lattice memory by meaning, across every layer you can see — not just the shared library. Use this to recall past work, decisions and context.
vett.name: search_lattice_by_embedding

query.description: Search query to embed and compare against lattice nodes.

vett.description: Search Aetheria's lattice by content or tag keywords.
vett.name: search_lattice_by_keywords

keywords.description: Keywords to search for in lattice content and tags.

vett.description: Search the shared library layer for verified reference material. Library entries are written by any agent and visible to all. Returns matches with content, the agent who wrote it, tags, timestamp, and similarity score.
vett.name: search_library

k.description: How many results to return at most. Default 5, cap 25.

query.description: Natural-language search query. Embedding similarity is computed against library entries; the closest matches above the threshold are returned.

threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0-1.0) to include a result. Default 0.5. Lower = more recall, higher = more precision.

vett.description: Read live status of the DGX Spark (10.10.10.2): whether it is reachable, what vLLM reports, and which containers are running. Vett and Scotty run their inference there. Read-only. If the probe fails it returns ok=false — treat that as 'unknown', never as 'healthy'.
vett.name: spark_status

vett.description: Read the LIVE host inventory (GPUs, CPU, memory, network, motherboard) from this machine, so facts about 'this box' have a real source instead of a guess. Read-only; backed by a fixed allowlist (nvidia-smi/lscpu/free/lspci/DMI). Use this to verify any claim about the hardware SOVERYN is running on.
vett.name: system_probe

category.description: Which host inventory to read: gpu, cpu, mem, net, board, or all. Read-only; runs a fixed allowlist of commands.

vett.description: Move a coordination node through the Open -> Refining -> Ready lifecycle. Invalid transitions (e.g. backwards or skipping states) are rejected. Archive has its own tool because it requires a Lesson Learned payload.
vett.name: update_coordination_status

new_status.description: Target status. Open->Refining->Ready only via this tool; Archived requires archive_coordination_node.

node_id.description: ID of the coord node to transition.

vett.description: Edit a document's title, body content, or lifecycle status. A full-body rewrite via 'content' is supported — this is how you complete or finalize a document. For incremental edits to a large document, append_to_document and replace_in_document are cheaper alternatives. Supply at least one of title, content, or status. Returns {id, updated: bool}.
vett.name: update_document

content.description: Replacement Markdown body — writes the COMPLETE document. Omit to leave the content unchanged. For growing or tweaking an already-large document, append_to_document (add a section) and replace_in_document (change one passage) are cheaper because they send only the delta — but a full rewrite here is fully supported whenever you want it.

id.description: UUID of the document to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status: 'draft' while working, 'final' when ready for Jon to download, 'archived' to retire it.

title.description: New title. Omit to leave it unchanged.

vett.description: Search the web (Brave Search API, SearXNG fallback). Returns title, url, and a short snippet per result. Use fetch_url to read a full page from a returned URL.
vett.name: web_search

query.description: The search query.

vett.description: Persist a verified fact or piece of reference material to the shared library layer in the lattice. Library entries are permanent, cross-agent visible, and stable (no lifecycle states). Use for things you've actually verified — for unverified leads, post a Signal to the coordination boards instead. Library writes do NOT trigger webhook events; other agents see them when they next search the library or via their heartbeat's lattice-activity summary.
vett.name: write_library_node

content.description: The verified fact / reference material to persist (≤800 chars). Library entries are permanent reference material visible to every agent — use this for things you've verified and would want your future self (and the rest of the fleet) to be able to look up. NOT for unverified leads (those go to Signal board). Oversized content is refused; rewrite shorter.

tags.description: Optional list of short string tags for grouping (e.g. ['funding', 'eu', 'horizon-europe']). Helps later discovery; not required.
